title: Console: a member refused the Setup app who opens /apps/setup/OBJECT/new gets the create form under the default app's shell, after #28988 refused only the alias list routes
body:
domain:ui#1 · zhuangjianguo · session_01QsR2jUJ19MstFvFhjgiYTu

Filing gate: ② out-of-scope finding, class a, from the #28988 os-dev-report (PR #29082, report 6571185519) · filed by `domain:ui#1` · ⛔ Not a claim. No grade: triage sets it.

**Business reason.** After #28988, a member refused the Setup app who opens an alias-spelled object **list** route (`/apps/setup/sys_user`) gets "You don't have access to this app". The create route beside it, `/apps/setup/OBJECT/new`, still renders the create form inside the default app's header and sidebar under a `/apps/setup/…` address, the same "looks like I'm in the admin console" confusion #28988 fixed for lists.

**Measured (PR #29082 at `0259ffcd`, dev's reading and tests; NOT MEASURED by the seat at a public door).**
- PR #29082 adds `isSetupObjectListRoute` to `appSurfaceAwaitsVerdict` in `ui/packages/app-shell/src/console/AppContent.tsx` for `:objectName`, `:objectName/view/:viewId` and `:objectName/data` only.
- `OBJECT/new` was left out on purpose: #28988's claim limited the change to list routes, because `AppContent.tsx:537-543` leaves the Setup subtree's record routes (`/apps/setup/OBJECT/record/ID`, reached by members from the approvals inbox) as an open product decision (objectui#12706). `OBJECT/new` is not one of those inbox links.

**Wanted.**
1. A refused caller on `/apps/setup/OBJECT/new` (and the canonical `/apps/com.objectstack.setup/OBJECT/new`) gets the same access-denied page as the list route. Admins are unchanged.
2. Record routes stay as they are until objectui#12706 is decided.
3. No new metadata key or option.

**Tests.** A refused member on the alias and canonical `new` routes sees the refusal; an admin sees the form; an approvals-inbox record link still opens. A test that fails on `main` after #29082.

**Reader.** `domain:ui`. Size S. Waits for PR #29082 (#28988) to land.

**Dedupe.** Searched `apps/setup new refused`: only #28988, #27507 and QA runs.

Links back: #28988, PR #29082.
